caption_candidates.text: FIGURE 1 The unmarked representative figure MRI of rotator cuff injury (A, B).
FIGURE 2 Representative figure MRI of rotator cuff injury were tested for lateral acromial angle followed up at 6 months before and after surgery (A, B). Red indicates marker lines.
FIGURE 3 Shoulder MRI was performed at 24 months after surgery (A–D). The rivets used in rotator cuff repair can be clearly seen while we took LAA angle measurements and analyzed the results.
FIGURE 4 Surgery related repair integrity (RI) at 6, 12, 18 and 24 months between single and double row acromioplasty.

FIGURE 5 Spearmen analysis between single or double row acromioplasty and functional assessment such as University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) quick disability of the shoulder and arm, shoulder and hand (qDASH) score in 12 months after surgery. LAA, lateral acromial angle; RI, rotator interval
